name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A complete 'how to build software with an AI coding agent, done right' methodology — a set of reusable skills plus a process that keeps the AI disciplined instead of freewheeling.
buyer: An engineering leader rolling out AI coding agents across a team who wants a proven process, not just raw AI access, so quality and consistency don't fall apart at scale.
business_use_cases: An engineering org adopts it as the standard methodology every team's AI agent follows across projects.
A dev-tools consultancy builds a paid 'AI engineering process rollout' offering around installing and training teams on it.
An open-source project requires contributors to follow this methodology when submitting AI-assisted PRs to keep quality high.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid consulting to roll this methodology out across an engineering org, including training and customization.
Build premium extensions or industry-specific skill packs on top of the open framework and sell them.

steal_this: This weekend, run one real client project end-to-end using this methodology, document the before/after quality difference, and use it as a case study to sell the rollout service.
